## Tutors Reader Codebase: Gap & Opportunity Analysis

### CRITICAL

**1. All `{@html}` usages lack DOMPurify sanitization -- XSS risk**
Despite notes that DOMPurify was added, **zero** instances of DOMPurify exist in the codebase (`grep` returned no matches). All 15 `{@html}` usages render unsanitized HTML sourced from course JSON or markdown conversion. This is the single largest security gap.

Affected files (every `{@html}` usage):
- `src/routes/(auth)/auth/TutorsTerms.svelte:29` -- `{@html content}`
- `src/routes/(course-reader)/search/[courseid]/+page.svelte:98` -- `{@html result.html}`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Video.svelte:60` -- `{@html lo.summary}`
- `src/routes/(course-reader)/llm/[courseid]/+page.svelte:30-31` -- `{@html headdingHtml}`, `{@html data.llmsLinks}`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoReference.svelte:30` -- `{@html lo.title}`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Lab.svelte:67,76,85` -- navbar + content HTML
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Note.svelte:22` -- `{@html lo.contentHtml}`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Podcast.svelte:30` -- `{@html lo.summary}`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Card.svelte:104` -- `{@html cardDetails.summary}`
- `src/lib/ui/navigators/footers/TutorsMessage.svelte:18` -- `{@html contentHtml}`
- `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/InfoButton.svelte:19` -- `{@html currentCourse?.value?.contentHtml}`

**Fix:** Install `isomorphic-dompurify`, wrap every `{@html X}` with `{@html DOMPurify.sanitize(X)}`.

**2. Non-null assertions on potentially missing data cause runtime crashes**
`src/lib/services/course/services/course.svelte.ts` lines 82, 122, 144 use `return topic!`, `return wall!`, `return lo!`. If a courseId/topicId/loId has no match in the index, these return `undefined` while the type says they will not, leading to downstream crashes with no error message.

**Fix:** Throw descriptive errors when lookups fail, or return `undefined` explicitly and update callers.

---

### HIGH

**3. WebSocket connections never closed -- memory leak**
`src/lib/services/community/services/live.svelte.ts:91-98` -- `startCoursePresenceListener` creates a new `PartySocket` every call but never closes the previous one. Same pattern in `presence.svelte.ts:60-65`. Repeated course navigation accumulates orphaned WebSocket connections.

**Fix:** Close `this.partyKitCourse` before creating a new one (`this.partyKitCourse.close?.()`).

**4. No security headers in server hooks**
`src/hooks.server.ts` only configures auth. No CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers. The app renders third-party iframes (Spotify, video providers) and `{@html}` content with no CSP to limit script execution.

**Fix:** Add a `handle` sequence hook that sets `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, etc.

**5. Supabase anon key exposed client-side with no RLS verification**
`src/lib/services/community/utils/supabase-client.ts:18` creates a Supabase client with the anon key. All database operations use this client directly. If Row Level Security (RLS) is not configured on every table, any user can read/modify any student's analytics data. The `learning_records` table is upserted based on `student_id` provided by the client (line 184-202) -- a client can forge another student's ID.

**Fix:** Verify RLS is enforced on all tables; consider using server-side API routes for writes.

**6. `$effect` triggers infinite loop risk in TalkMozilla.svelte**
`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkMozilla.svelte:33-38` -- `$effect` reads `lo.pdf`, sets state (`loading`, `pageNum`), and calls `loadDoc()` which sets more state. If `lo` is reactive, this could re-trigger.

---

### MEDIUM

**7. Analytics timer (`setInterval`) not guaranteed to be cleaned up**
`src/lib/services/connect/services/connect.svelte.ts:198` -- `startTimer()` creates a 30-second interval. `stopTimer()` exists (line 209) but there is no evidence it is called on page unload or component destroy. If the user navigates away, the interval continues firing.

**Fix:** Call `stopTimer()` in a cleanup handler, or use `onDestroy`.

**8. Missing types -- `as any` casts**
- `src/hooks.client.ts:5` -- `(globalThis as any).__TUTORS_TIME_SUPABASE_INIT__`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoContextTree.svelte:14,25` -- multiple `as any` casts
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/LoContext.svelte:20` -- `(lo as any)?.toc`
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/TalkMozilla.svelte:4` -- `// @ts-ignore` on FileSaver import

**9. Empty alt attributes on images -- accessibility**
`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/Card.svelte:75,96` and `src/lib/ui/time/StudentCard.svelte:101` use `alt=""`. For decorative images this is correct, but these are course/student images that convey meaning. Only 6 total `aria-*` attributes exist across all UI components and zero `role=` attributes.

**Fix:** Populate alt text from `cardDetails.title` or student name; add ARIA landmarks to navigation regions.

**10. Runtime dependencies misclassified as devDependencies**
`package.json` places `@auth/sveltekit`, `@supabase/supabase-js`, `partysocket`, `pdfjs-dist`, `file-saver`, `shiki`, `@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`, and `@iconify/svelte` under `devDependencies`. These are runtime imports. For SSR deployments, the build host may not install devDeps in production.

**Fix:** Move runtime packages to `dependencies`.

**11. `pdfjs-dist` imported in full -- bundle size**
`TalkMozilla.svelte:2` does `import * as pdfjs from "pdfjs-dist"` -- this pulls the entire PDF.js library (~500KB+) into the main bundle even for courses with no PDFs. No dynamic import is used.

**Fix:** Use `const pdfjs = await import('pdfjs-dist')` inside `onMount`.

- `search/+page.svelte:66-72` -- commented-out `$effect` block
- `supabase-client.ts:323-326` -- commented-out function calls
- `presence.svelte.ts:31` -- commented-out filter condition

**14. Custom UUID generator instead of `crypto.randomUUID()`**
`src/lib/services/community/services/presence.svelte.ts:141-146` uses a Math.random()-based UUID generator. `crypto.randomUUID()` is available in all modern browsers and is cryptographically random.

**15. Hardcoded domain in search results**
`src/routes/(course-reader)/search/[courseid]/+page.svelte:52` -- `result.link = "https://tutors.dev/${result.link}"` hardcodes the production domain, breaking local dev and other deployments.

**16. Session maxAge set to 1 year**
`src/hooks.server.ts:41` -- `maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365`. This is unusually long for a JWT session, increasing the window for token theft.

## Tutors Reader Codebase: Gap & Opportunity Analysis (development branch)

### CRITICAL

**1. Zero DOMPurify sanitization across 14 `{@html}` usages -- XSS**
Despite the commit message on `fix/critical-issues` claiming DOMPurify was added, `grep` for `DOMPurify` returns zero matches on `development`. Every `{@html}` renders unsanitized HTML from course JSON or markdown conversion. Course authors can inject arbitrary scripts.

Affected: `Lab.svelte:67,76,85`, `Note.svelte:22`, `Card.svelte:104`, `Video.svelte:60`, `Podcast.svelte:30`, `LoReference.svelte:30`, `InfoButton.svelte:19`, `TutorsMessage.svelte:18`, `TutorsTerms.svelte:29`, `search/+page.svelte:98`, `llm/+page.svelte:30-31`.

Fix: Install `isomorphic-dompurify`, wrap every `{@html X}` with `{@html DOMPurify.sanitize(X)}`.

**2. Non-null assertions on fallible lookups cause silent crashes**
`src/lib/services/course/services/course.svelte.ts` lines 82, 122, 144 use `return topic!`, `return wall!`, `return lo!`. When an ID has no match in the Map, `undefined` is returned but the type system hides it, causing downstream TypeError crashes with no actionable error.

Fix: Throw descriptive errors (e.g., `throw new Error("Topic not found: " + topicId)`) or return `| undefined` and update callers.

**3. SearchButton MutationObserver on entire DOM, never disconnected**
`src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/SearchButton.svelte:38-42` creates a `MutationObserver` on `document.body` with `{ childList: true, subtree: true }` at module scope. It fires on every DOM mutation across the entire page and is never disconnected. This is both a severe performance drain and a memory leak.

Fix: Replace with `afterNavigate` from `$app/navigation` to detect URL changes.

---

### HIGH

**4. WebSocket connections never closed -- connection leak**
`src/lib/services/community/services/presence.svelte.ts:60` and `live.svelte.ts:91` create new `PartySocket` instances on each call to `startPresenceListener`/`startCoursePresenceListener` without closing the previous one. Navigating between courses accumulates orphaned WebSocket connections.

Fix: Call `this.partyKitCourse.close()` before creating a new socket.

**5. No security headers anywhere**
`src/hooks.server.ts` only handles auth. No CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, or Referrer-Policy. The `svelte.config.js` has no `kit.csp` configuration. Combined with the `{@html}` XSS vectors, there is no defense in depth.

Fix: Add a sequence hook that injects response headers, or configure `kit.csp`.

**6. Analytics interval never stopped on navigation**
`src/routes/(course-reader)/+layout.svelte:12` calls `tutorsConnectService.startTimer()` (30-second `setInterval`). No component ever calls `stopTimer()`. The interval accumulates if the layout remounts.

Fix: Return a cleanup function from `onMount`, or call `stopTimer()` in `onDestroy`.

**7. Multiple event listener leaks**
- `Cards.svelte:37` -- `keydown` listener added in `onMount`, no `onDestroy` to remove.
- `TalkAdobe.svelte:79` -- `adobe_dc_view_sdk.ready` listener added with anonymous function (impossible to remove).
- `EditCoursButton.svelte:29` -- `page.subscribe()` never calls unsubscribe.

**8. Supabase client-side writes without verified RLS**
`src/lib/services/community/utils/supabase-client.ts:18` creates a Supabase client with the anon key. All upserts (learning_records, calendar, tutors-connect-users) use client-supplied `student_id`. Without strict RLS, any user can write data as another student.

---

### MEDIUM

**9. 10+ runtime dependencies listed as devDependencies**
`package.json` places `@auth/sveltekit`, `@supabase/supabase-js`, `partysocket`, `pdfjs-dist`, `file-saver`, `shiki`, `@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`, `@iconify/svelte`, `jheat.js`, and `svelte` under `devDependencies`. These all run in production. This works with Vite bundling but breaks on platforms that skip devDeps in production installs.

**10. Shiki statically imports 31 languages and 7 themes**
`src/lib/services/markdown/services/markdown.svelte.ts:11-52` eagerly imports all language grammars. Includes a duplicate TypeScript import (lines 23 and 32). This adds significant weight to the initial bundle.

Fix: Use `createHighlighterCore` with lazy language loading, remove unused languages (Haskell, Scala, R, Vue, Dockerfile).

`TalkMozilla.svelte:2` does `import * as pdfjs from "pdfjs-dist"` (~500KB+). While `TalkClient.svelte` lazy-loads the component, the import is still not dynamic within the component itself.

- `hooks.client.ts:5` -- `(globalThis as any)`
- `LoContextTree.svelte:14,25` -- multiple `as any` casts
- `LoContext.svelte:20` -- `(lo as any)?.toc`
- `TalkMozilla.svelte:22-29` -- `canvas: any`, `pdfDoc: any`, `pages: any`
- `hooks.server.ts:14` -- `profile: any` with eslint-disable

`Card.svelte:75,96` and `StudentCard.svelte:101` use `alt=""` on images that convey course/student content. Only 6 `aria-*` attributes exist across all UI components. Zero `role` attributes found.

Additional a11y issues:
- `InfoButton.svelte:18` uses `<prose>` (not a valid HTML element).
- `Breadcrumbs.svelte:48` suppresses `a11y_no_static_element_interactions` warning instead of fixing it.
- `CourseVisitCard.svelte:35` has icon-only buttons with no `aria-label`.

**14. Mixed Svelte 4/5 patterns**
- `SearchButton.svelte:48` uses `on:click` (Svelte 4) while all others use `onclick` (Svelte 5).
- `EditCoursButton.svelte:29` uses `$app/stores` with `.subscribe()` instead of Svelte 5's `$app/state`.
- `SearchButton.svelte:6` accesses `sessionStorage` at module scope (crashes during SSR).

**15. Race condition in updateCourseList**
`src/lib/services/connect/utils/allCourseAccess.ts:15-41` does SELECT then UPSERT non-atomically. Two concurrent visitors read the same `visit_count` and both increment to the same value, losing one count. The `increment_calendar` RPC pattern used elsewhere is the correct approach.

**16. $effect misuse creating potential infinite loops**
`TalkMozilla.svelte:33-38` -- `$effect` reads `lo.pdf` and writes to multiple `$state` variables (`loading`, `url`, `pageNum`), then calls `loadDoc()` which writes more state. Risk of infinite re-triggering.

`Video.svelte:27-31` -- `$state` + `$effect` pattern should just be `$derived`.

---

### LOW

**17. 1-year JWT session maxAge**
`hooks.server.ts:41` -- `maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365`. If a token is stolen it remains valid for a year. 7-30 days is standard.

**18. SSR disabled on all 13 content routes**
Every route under `(course-reader)` sets `ssr = false`. No server-side rendering means no SEO indexability and slower first paint.

**19. Adobe SDK loaded without SRI**
`TalkAdobe.svelte:41` injects `https://acrobatservices.adobe.com/view-sdk/viewer.js` as a script with no Subresource Integrity hash.

**20. Dead code and debug artifacts**
- `supabase-client.ts:271` -- `getDurationTotal()` defined but never called.
- `TalkAdobe.svelte:67` -- `console.log` left in `$effect`.
- `TalkMozilla.svelte:60-63` -- commented-out worker cleanup.
- `search/+page.svelte:66-72` -- commented-out `$effect`.
- `presence.svelte.ts:141-146` -- custom UUID via `Math.random()` instead of `crypto.randomUUID()`.

**21. Hardcoded domain in search results**
`search/+page.svelte:52` -- `result.link = "https://tutors.dev/${result.link}"` breaks local dev and alternative deployments.

**22. Unauthenticated GitHub API calls with no caching**
`supabase-client.ts:358` -- `fetch("https://api.github.com/users/${student.login}")` hits the 60 req/hour rate limit with no caching or token.

**23. Props mutation**
`LoContext.svelte:9-16` directly mutates `lo.toc` children's `route` property. In Svelte 5, props should be immutable; this mutation affects all components sharing the same `Lo` objects.
